_about: Every input of the cost model (scripts/quality/cost.mts), in one place. Each has a value and a source: a provider page with the date it was read, a measurement in this repository, or "assumption" (a number to replace with a measurement or the owner's own figure). Prices in USD. Plans, prices, caps and the trial come from shared/src/plans.json, not from here.

dbComputeCredit.source: Supabase Pro includes $10 compute credit, read 2026-11-12

dbPitrMonthly.source: Supabase point-in-time recovery (7 days), read 2026-11-12; planned from the first paying customer (HANDOVER)

r2EgressPerGb.source: R2 pricing: no egress fees, read 2026-11-12

domainsMonthly.source: assumption: two domains (app + portal) at about $15 a year each

workspaceSeatMonthly.source: assumption: Google Workspace Business Starter, one user (the relay sender); check workspace.google.com/pricing

relayRecipientsPerDay.source: assumption: Google's published SMTP relay limit per user (not re-read this run)

resendTiers.source: resend.com/pricing, read 2026-11-12 (fallback only when the relay limit is reached)

feeOnTaxInclusive.source: assumption: Paddle's percentage applies to the total the buyer pays, tax included (conservative)

prices.source: api/src/assistant/cost.ts PRICES (Anthropic price list read 2026-11-19), USD per million tokens

freshInputTokens.source: api/src/assistant/cost.ts TYPICAL (measured on the evaluation set's shape, b2-assistant)

answerCacheHitShare.source: assumption (b2-assistant estimate): questions answered again from the answer cache cost $0

sonnetShare.source: assumption: half the model answers on Sonnet, half on Haiku. The shipped default is Sonnet only (ASSISTANT_MODEL); a mix needs a router (owner question)

questionsPerSeatTypical.source: assumption: model-answered CuraAI questions and drafts per full seat a month

worstCase.source: assumption: every question at the plan cap, all on Sonnet, nothing from the answer cache

aiTeamMonthlyCap.source: HANDOVER running costs: AI team cap $40 a month by default (fixed, whole install)

apiCallsPerOpen.source: measured: scripts/quality/browser.mts load (19 requests, 15 to the API)

pollsPerDay.source: measured in code (web/src/lib/live.ts: every 30 s in front, 90 s idle) with assumption 3 h + 3 h a day

cpuMsPerRequest.source: assumption until measured on Workers (Cloudflare's own average is 2.2 ms)

dbMbPerSeat.source: measured: scripts/perf.ts, 422 MB for a 306-person company

mailsPerSeat.source: assumption: a third get notices by mail, two a working day, plus sign-in links and the weekly summary

fileGbPerSeatTypical.source: assumption: attachments kept per seat after a year

fileEgressGbPerSeat.source: assumption (R2 egress is free, kept for a provider change)

viewersPerSeat.source: assumption: one free viewer for every four full seats

viewerActivity.source: assumption: a viewer is a fifth as active

connectorsTypical.source: assumption: one connected CRM or spreadsheet per company

cpuMsPerRun.source: assumption: one incremental sync run (paging, mapping, writes) on Workers

requestsPerRun.source: assumption: the scheduled invocation plus follow-on pages ('more')

outboundApiCost.source: the customer's CRM / spreadsheet API quota pays for the calls; Workers subrequests are not billed separately (Workers pricing)

hourlyCost.source: assumption: the owner's or a contractor's hour

minutesPerCompanyMonth.source: assumption: questions the help centre and CuraAI do not answer

minutesPerTrial.source: assumption: reviewing the request, approval, one check-in

conversion.source: assumption: one approved trial in four becomes a paying company

customerLifetimeMonths.source: assumption: trial cost is spread over this many paid months

TRY.source: assumption (unverified FX); no TRY list yet

customers.source: the owner's brief for the pricing session (G8)

teamMix.source: assumption: ICP 20-300-person B2B (research-competitive), teams of 5 / 12 / 40 full seats

plan.source: assumption: price the scenarios on the cheapest plan (the owner's rule: cheapest possible)

interval.source: assumption: monthly billing (Paddle's fixed $0.50 hurts most there)

pitrFromCustomers.source: HANDOVER: point-in-time recovery from the first paying customer
